newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares rangebound in sluggish early bourse.
newsitem.headline: German shares rangebound in sluggish early bourse.

text.p: German shares traded mostly sideways in early bourse trade on Monday, as a lack of significant market-moving information left the market looking around for inspiration and finding little of substance.
Support came from the ongoing strength of the dollar at 1.69 marks and the DAX index stood at 3,260.49 points, up 0.85 points or 0.03 percent early on.
"The market is a bit confused -- everyone seemed to be a winner in the Hesse state elections and there is little news around to lift shares," said a Frankfurt trader.

"Everyone seems to be waiting around for some piece of data. There are German unemployment figures coming out (on Thursday) and there are U.S. jobless figures due out as well this week," said one trader.
Early features included chemicals Hoechst AG and BASF AG. Hoechst was up 35 pfennigs at 71.95 marks, while BASF was up 45 marks at 62.70 marks.
Elsewhere, speculation that Adidas had signed a $100 million sports sponsorship deal with the U.S. baseball team New York Yankees lifted shares in Adidas by four marks to 165.50 marks.
